lines.text: Many learners say: I am interesting in music.
Better: I am interested in music.
Interested! I am interested in art.

native.tip: 내 마음은 interested! “I am interested in music”이에요.
native.caption: “I am interesting in music”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 내가 느끼는 감정은 interested, 대상의 성질은 interesting이에요. “I am interested in music”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “interested”. 관심 있다는 interested! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: For your own feeling, say interested. “I am interested in music”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am interesting in music”? 😅 Your own feeling is “interested”. A thing is “interesting”. “I am interested in music” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
